verses.original: הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י בַּחֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ הַזֶּ֔ה בַּיּ֣וֹם בְּנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְצֵ֥את מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם בָּ֖אוּ מִדְבַּ֥ר סִינָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: haš·šə·lî·šî ba·ḥō·ḏeš haz·zeh bay·yō·wm bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl lə·ṣêṯ mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim bā·’ū miḏ·bar sî·nāy
verses.literal: In the third month on the same day [of the month] that the Israelites . . . had left the land of Egypt they came [to] the Wilderness of Sinai

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֣וּ מֵרְפִידִ֗ים וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ מִדְבַּ֣ר סִינַ֔י וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וַיִּֽחַן־ שָׁ֥ם בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר נֶ֥גֶד הָהָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mê·rə·p̄î·ḏîm way·yā·ḇō·’ū miḏ·bar sî·nay way·ya·ḥă·nū yiś·rā·’êl way·yi·ḥan- šām bam·miḏ·bār ne·ḡeḏ hā·hār
verses.literal: After they had set out from Rephidim they entered the Wilderness of Sinai - and Israel camped there - in front of the mountain

verses.original: וּמֹשֶׁ֥ה עָלָ֖ה אֶל־ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים יְהוָה֙ וַיִּקְרָ֨א אֵלָ֤יו מִן־ הָהָ֣ר כֹּ֤ה תֹאמַר֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לְבֵ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְתַגֵּ֖יד לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mō·šeh ‘ā·lāh ’el- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm Yah·weh way·yiq·rā ’ê·lāw min- hā·hār kōh ṯō·mar lê·mōr lə·ḇêṯ ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·ṯag·gêḏ liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Then Moses went up to God and the LORD called to him from the mountain This is what . . . you are to tell the house of Jacob and explain to the sons of Israel

verses.original: אַתֶּ֣ם רְאִיתֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֖יתִי לְמִצְרָ֑יִם וָאֶשָּׂ֤א אֶתְכֶם֙ עַל־ נְשָׁרִ֔ים כַּנְפֵ֣י וָאָבִ֥א אֶתְכֶ֖ם אֵלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tem rə·’î·ṯem ’ă·šer ‘ā·śî·ṯî lə·miṣ·rā·yim wā·’eś·śā ’eṯ·ḵem ‘al- nə·šā·rîm kan·p̄ê wā·’ā·ḇi ’eṯ·ḵem ’ê·lāy
verses.literal: You have seen for yourselves what I did to Egypt and how I carried - you on eagles’ wings and brought you to Myself

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה אִם־ שָׁמ֤וֹעַ תִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ בְּקֹלִ֔י וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֑י וִהְיִ֨יתֶם לִ֤י סְגֻלָּה֙ מִכָּל־ הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים כִּי־ כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃ לִ֖י
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ’im- šā·mō·w·a‘ tiš·mə·‘ū bə·qō·lî ū·šə·mar·tem ’eṯ- bə·rî·ṯî wih·yî·ṯem lî sə·ḡul·lāh mik·kāl hā·‘am·mîm kî- kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ lî
verses.literal: Now if you will indeed obey . . . My voice and keep - My covenant you will be My treasured possession out of all the nations for the whole earth is Mine

verses.original: לִ֛י וְאַתֶּ֧ם תִּהְיוּ־ מַמְלֶ֥כֶת כֹּהֲנִ֖ים קָד֑וֹשׁ וְג֣וֹי אֵ֚לֶּה הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר תְּדַבֵּ֖ר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: lî wə·’at·tem tih·yū- mam·le·ḵeṯ kō·hă·nîm qā·ḏō·wōš wə·ḡō·w ’êl·leh had·də·ḇā·rîm ’ă·šer tə·ḏab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And unto Me you shall be a kingdom of priests and a holy nation These are the words that you are to speak to the Israelites . . .

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַיָּבֹ֣א וַיִּקְרָ֖א לְזִקְנֵ֣י הָעָ֑ם וַיָּ֣שֶׂם לִפְנֵיהֶ֗ם אֵ֚ת כָּל־ הָאֵ֔לֶּה הַדְּבָרִ֣ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃ צִוָּ֖הוּ
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·yā·ḇō way·yiq·rā lə·ziq·nê hā·‘ām way·yā·śem lip̄·nê·hem ’êṯ kāl- hā·’êl·leh had·də·ḇā·rîm ’ă·šer Yah·weh ṣiw·wā·hū
verses.literal: So Moses went back and summoned the elders of the people and set before them all these words that the LORD had commanded him

verses.original: כָל־ הָעָ֤ם וַיַּעֲנ֨וּ יַחְדָּו֙ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ נַעֲשֶׂ֑ה כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֶּ֥ר מֹשֶׁ֛ה וַיָּ֧שֶׁב אֶת־ הָעָ֖ם דִּבְרֵ֥י אֶל־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ḵāl hā·‘ām way·ya·‘ă·nū yaḥ·dāw way·yō·mə·rū na·‘ă·śeh kōl ’ă·šer- Yah·weh dib·ber mō·šeh way·yā·šeḇ ’eṯ- hā·‘ām diḇ·rê ’el- Yah·weh
verses.literal: And all the people answered together . . . We will do everything that the LORD has spoken So Moses brought - [their] words back to the LORD

verses.original: יְהוָ֜ה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י בָּ֣א אֵלֶיךָ֮ בְּעַ֣ב הֶֽעָנָן֒ בַּעֲב֞וּר הָעָם֙ יִשְׁמַ֤ע בְּדַבְּרִ֣י עִמָּ֔ךְ וְגַם־ לְעוֹלָ֑ם יַאֲמִ֣ינוּ בְּךָ֖ מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת־ וַיַּגֵּ֥ד אֶל־ יְהוָֽה׃ הָעָ֖ם דִּבְרֵ֥י
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’el- mō·šeh hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî bā ’ê·le·ḵā bə·‘aḇ he·‘ā·nān ba·‘ă·ḇūr hā·‘ām yiš·ma‘ bə·ḏab·bə·rî ‘im·māḵ wə·ḡam- lə·‘ō·w·lām ya·’ă·mî·nū bə·ḵā mō·šeh ’eṯ- way·yag·gêḏ ’el- Yah·weh hā·‘ām diḇ·rê
verses.literal: The LORD said to Moses Behold I will come to you in a dense cloud so that the people will hear when I speak with you and they will always put their trust in you And Moses - relayed to the LORD [what] the people had said

verses.original: יְהוָ֤ה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁה֙ לֵ֣ךְ אֶל־ אֶל־ הָעָ֔ם וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֥ם הַיּ֖וֹם וּמָחָ֑ר וְכִבְּס֖וּ שִׂמְלֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer mō·šeh lêḵ ’el- ’el- hā·‘ām wə·qid·daš·tām hay·yō·wm ū·mā·ḥār wə·ḵib·bə·sū śim·lō·ṯām
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses Go . . . to the people and consecrate them today and tomorrow They must wash their clothes

verses.original: וְהָי֥וּ נְכֹנִ֖ים הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֑י לַיּ֣וֹם כִּ֣י׀ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֗י בַּיּ֣וֹם יְהוָ֛ה יֵרֵ֧ד עַל־ הַ֥ר סִינָֽי׃ לְעֵינֵ֥י כָל־ הָעָ֖ם
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yū nə·ḵō·nîm haš·šə·lî·šî lay·yō·wm kî haš·šə·lî·šî bay·yō·wm Yah·weh yê·rêḏ ‘al- har sî·nāy lə·‘ê·nê ḵāl hā·‘ām
verses.literal: and be prepared by the third day for on the third day the LORD will come down on Mount Sinai in the sight of all the people

verses.original: וְהִגְבַּלְתָּ֤ אֶת־ הָעָם֙ סָבִ֣יב לֵאמֹ֔ר הִשָּׁמְר֥וּ לָכֶ֛ם עֲל֥וֹת בָּהָ֖ר וּנְגֹ֣עַ בְּקָצֵ֑הוּ כָּל־ הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בָּהָ֖ר מ֥וֹת יוּמָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiḡ·bal·tā ’eṯ- hā·‘ām sā·ḇîḇ lê·mōr hiš·šā·mə·rū lā·ḵem ‘ă·lō·wṯ bā·hār ū·nə·ḡō·a‘ bə·qā·ṣê·hū kāl- han·nō·ḡê·a‘ bā·hār mō·wṯ yū·māṯ
verses.literal: And you are to set up a boundary - for the people around [the mountain] and tell them Be careful not to go up on the mountain or touch its base Whoever touches the mountain shall surely be put to death . . .

verses.original: לֹא־ יָ֗ד תִגַּ֨ע בּ֜וֹ כִּֽי־ סָק֤וֹל יִסָּקֵל֙ אוֹ־ יָרֹ֣ה יִיָּרֶ֔ה אִם־ אִ֖ישׁ אִם־ בְּהֵמָ֥ה לֹ֣א יִחְיֶ֑ה הַיֹּבֵ֔ל בִּמְשֹׁךְ֙ הֵ֖מָּה יַעֲל֥וּ בָהָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: lō- yāḏ ṯig·ga‘ bōw kî- sā·qō·wl yis·sā·qêl ’ōw- yā·rōh yî·yā·reh ’im- ’îš ’im- bə·hê·māh lō yiḥ·yeh hay·yō·ḇêl bim·šōḵ hêm·māh ya·‘ă·lū ḇā·hār
verses.literal: No hand shall touch him but he shall surely be stoned . . . or shot with arrows whether man or beast he must not live Only when the ram’s horn sounds a long blast may they approach the mountain

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֛ה וַיֵּ֧רֶד מִן־ הָהָ֖ר אֶל־ הָעָ֑ם וַיְקַדֵּשׁ֙ אֶת־ הָעָ֔ם וַֽיְכַבְּס֖וּ שִׂמְלֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·yê·reḏ min- hā·hār ’el- hā·‘ām way·qad·dêš ’eṯ- hā·‘ām way·ḵab·bə·sū śim·lō·ṯām
verses.literal: When Moses came down from the mountain to the people he consecrated them - - and they washed their clothes

verses.original: הֱי֥וּ נְכֹנִ֖ים לִשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֑ים וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ הָעָ֔ם אַֽל־ תִּגְּשׁ֖וּ אֶל־ אִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: hĕ·yū nə·ḵō·nîm liš·lō·šeṯ yā·mîm way·yō·mer ’el- hā·‘ām ’al- tig·gə·šū ’el- ’iš·šāh
verses.literal: Be prepared for the third day he said to the people Do not draw near to a woman

verses.original: הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֜י בַיּ֨וֹם הַבֹּ֗קֶר וַיְהִי֩ וַיְהִי֩ בִּֽהְיֹ֣ת קֹלֹ֨ת וּבְרָקִ֜ים כָּבֵד֙ וְעָנָ֤ן עַל־ הָהָ֔ר חָזָ֣ק מְאֹ֑ד וְקֹ֥ל שֹׁפָ֖ר כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃ וַיֶּחֱרַ֥ד
verses.transliteration: haš·šə·lî·šî ḇay·yō·wm hab·bō·qer way·hî way·hî bih·yōṯ qō·lōṯ ū·ḇə·rā·qîm kā·ḇêḏ wə·‘ā·nān ‘al- hā·hār ḥā·zāq mə·’ōḏ wə·qōl šō·p̄ār kāl- hā·‘ām ’ă·šer bam·ma·ḥă·neh way·ye·ḥĕ·raḏ
verses.literal: On the third day when morning . . . came there was thunder and lightning A thick cloud was upon the mountain and a very loud . . . blast of the ram’s horn [went out] so that all the people - in the camp trembled

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֧ה אֶת־ וַיּוֹצֵ֨א הָעָ֛ם מִן־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה לִקְרַ֥את הָֽאֱלֹהִ֖ים וַיִּֽתְיַצְּב֖וּ בְּתַחְתִּ֥ית הָהָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh ’eṯ- way·yō·w·ṣê hā·‘ām min- ham·ma·ḥă·neh liq·raṯ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yiṯ·yaṣ·ṣə·ḇū bə·ṯaḥ·tîṯ hā·hār
verses.literal: Then Moses - brought the people out of the camp to meet with God and they stood at the foot of the mountain

verses.original: וְהַ֤ר סִינַי֙ כֻּלּ֔וֹ עָשַׁ֣ן מִ֠פְּנֵי אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָ֖ה יָרַ֥ד עָלָ֛יו בָּאֵ֑שׁ עֲשָׁנוֹ֙ וַיַּ֤עַל כְּעֶ֣שֶׁן הַכִּבְשָׁ֔ן כָּל־ הָהָ֖ר וַיֶּחֱרַ֥ד מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·har sî·nay kul·lōw ‘ā·šan mip·pə·nê ’ă·šer Yah·weh yā·raḏ ‘ā·lāw bā·’êš ‘ă·šā·nōw way·ya·‘al kə·‘e·šen hak·kiḇ·šān kāl- hā·hār way·ye·ḥĕ·raḏ mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: Mount Sinai was completely enveloped in smoke because - the LORD had descended on it in fire And the smoke rose like the smoke of a furnace and the whole mountain quaked violently

verses.original: וַיְהִי֙ ק֣וֹל הַשּׁוֹפָ֔ר הוֹלֵ֖ךְ וְחָזֵ֣ק מְאֹ֑ד מֹשֶׁ֣ה יְדַבֵּ֔ר וְהָאֱלֹהִ֖ים יַעֲנֶ֥נּוּ בְקֽוֹל׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî qō·wl haš·šō·w·p̄ār hō·w·lêḵ wə·ḥā·zêq mə·’ōḏ mō·šeh yə·ḏab·bêr wə·hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ya·‘ă·nen·nū ḇə·qō·wl
verses.literal: And as the sound of the ram’s horn grew louder . . . and louder Moses spoke and God answered him in the thunder

verses.original: יְהוָ֛ה וַיֵּ֧רֶד אֶל־ רֹ֣אשׁ הָהָ֑ר עַל־ הַ֥ר סִינַ֖י יְהוָ֧ה וַיִּקְרָ֨א לְמֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶל־ רֹ֥אשׁ הָהָ֖ר מֹשֶֽׁה׃ וַיַּ֥עַל
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yê·reḏ ’el- rōš hā·hār ‘al- har sî·nay Yah·weh way·yiq·rā lə·mō·šeh ’el- rōš hā·hār mō·šeh way·ya·‘al
verses.literal: The LORD descended to the top - of Mount Sinai [and] called Moses to the summit . . . So [Moses] went up

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֔ה רֵ֖ד הָעֵ֣ד בָּעָ֑ם פֶּן־ יֶהֶרְס֤וּ אֶל־ לִרְא֔וֹת יְהוָה֙ רָֽב׃ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ וְנָפַ֥ל
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’el- way·yō·mer mō·šeh rêḏ hā·‘êḏ bā·‘ām pen- ye·her·sū ’el- lir·’ō·wṯ Yah·weh rāḇ mim·men·nū wə·nā·p̄al
verses.literal: and the LORD . . . said to [him] Go down and warn the people not to break through . . . to see the LORD [lest] many of them perish

verses.original: וְגַ֧ם הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים הַנִּגָּשִׁ֥ים אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה יִתְקַדָּ֑שׁוּ פֶּן־ יְהוָֽה׃ יִפְרֹ֥ץ בָּהֶ֖ם
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam hak·kō·hă·nîm han·nig·gā·šîm ’el- Yah·weh yiṯ·qad·dā·šū pen- Yah·weh yip̄·rōṣ bā·hem
verses.literal: Even the priests who approach . . . the LORD must consecrate themselves or the LORD will break out against them

verses.original: מֹשֶׁה֙ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל־ יְהוָ֔ה הָעָ֔ם לֹא־ יוּכַ֣ל לַעֲלֹ֖ת אֶל־ הַ֣ר סִינָ֑י כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֞ה הַעֵדֹ֤תָה בָּ֙נוּ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הַגְבֵּ֥ל אֶת־ הָהָ֖ר וְקִדַּשְׁתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·yō·mer ’el- Yah·weh hā·‘ām lō- yū·ḵal la·‘ă·lōṯ ’el- har sî·nāy kî- ’at·tāh ha·‘ê·ḏō·ṯāh bā·nū lê·mōr haḡ·bêl ’eṯ- hā·hār wə·qid·daš·tōw
verses.literal: But Moses said to the LORD The people cannot . . . come up . . . Mount Sinai for You solemnly warned us . . . Put a boundary around - the mountain and set it apart as holy

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֤יו לֶךְ־ רֵ֔ד וְעָלִ֥יתָ וְאַהֲרֹ֣ן עִמָּ֑ךְ אַתָּ֖ה וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְהָעָ֗ם אַל־ יֶֽהֶרְס֛וּ לַעֲלֹ֥ת אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה פֶּן־ יִפְרָץ־ בָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw leḵ- rêḏ wə·‘ā·lî·ṯā wə·’a·hă·rōn ‘im·māḵ ’at·tāh wə·hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·hā·‘ām ’al- ye·her·sū la·‘ă·lōṯ ’el- Yah·weh pen- yip̄·rāṣ- bām
verses.literal: And the LORD replied - Go down and bring Aaron with you But the priests and the people must not break through to come up to the LORD or He will break out against them

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֖ה וַיֵּ֥רֶד אֶל־ הָעָ֑ם וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֲלֵהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·yê·reḏ ’el- hā·‘ām way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: So Moses went down to the people and spoke to them
